title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
廣東鄉試錄序
聖天子崇尚人文以臻至治億萬
斯年與天無極嘉靖四十年
廣東例當大比御史蔡結奉
命巡按寔監臨之方以得人為急
務乃申明
成憲百爾具舉藩臬諸臣嚮風承
===
流先事繕脩貢院禮聘文儒
戒勵有司儲備供億祗承
德意唯謹時則提督兵部右侍郎
兼僉都御史張臬始莅節鎮
廓清百粤副都御史楊伊志
綏定南韶總兵平江伯陳王
謨振揚戎旅戶部郎中戴科
punctuated:
廣東鄉試錄序

聖天子崇尚人文，以臻至治，億萬斯年，與天無極。嘉靖四十年，廣東例當大比，御史蔡結奉命巡按，寔監臨之，方以得人為急務，乃申明成憲，百爾具舉。藩臬諸臣嚮風承流，先事繕脩貢院，禮聘文儒，戒勵有司，儲備供億，祗承德意唯謹。時則提督兵部右侍郎兼僉都御史張臬始莅節鎮，廓清百粤；副都御史楊伊志綏定南韶；總兵平江伯陳王謨振揚戎旅；戶部郎中戴科
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Guangdong Provincial Examination

The sagely Son of Heaven honors and promotes literary culture to attain the highest order of government, enduring for countless millions of years, as boundless as Heaven. In the fortieth year of Jiajing [1561], Guangdong was due, according to established practice, to hold its triennial examination. Censor Cai Jie, commissioned to conduct an inspection tour, served as its Supervising Official. Taking the recruitment of worthy men as an urgent duty, he reaffirmed the established regulations, and every necessary measure was carried out. The officials of the Provincial Administration and Surveillance Commissions followed his example and direction. In advance of the examination, they repaired the examination compound, courteously invited learned scholars, admonished and encouraged the responsible officials, and stocked the necessary provisions, most reverently carrying out the emperor’s benevolent intentions. At this time, Zhang Nie, serving as Supreme Commander, Right Vice Minister of War, and concurrently Assistant Censor-in-Chief, had just taken up his regional command and was clearing disturbances throughout the Yue region. Vice Censor-in-Chief Yang Yizhi was pacifying Nanxiong and Shaozhou. Regional Commander Chen Wangmo, Earl of Pingjiang, was strengthening the military forces. Dai Ke, Director in the Ministry of Revenue, …

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
劑量軍需嶺海多士得以雍
容就試届期合提學僉事王
學顔所簡士二千七百有奇
鎖院而三試之以大昇及敎
諭黃士元爲考試官敎授秦
紹益敎諭孫耀童天胤曾諶
蕭標翟務忠曾士彥爲同考
===
試官經理于內者提調則左
布政使劉廷誥左叅政馮覲
監試則按察使熊逵副使張
子弘防範于外則左叅議馮
臯謨副使賀鏤鄭維誠宋大
武僉事皇甫渙李伸叅將鍾
坤秀張四維門崇文前期以
punctuated: 劑量軍需，嶺海多士得以雍容就試。届期，合提學僉事王學顔所簡士二千七百有奇，鎖院而三試之。以大昇及敎諭黃士元爲考試官，敎授秦紹益、敎諭孫耀、童天胤、曾諶、蕭標、翟務忠、曾士彥爲同考試官。經理于內者，提調則左布政使劉廷誥、左叅政馮覲；監試則按察使熊逵、副使張子弘。防範于外則左叅議馮臯謨、副使賀鏤、鄭維誠、宋大武、僉事皇甫渙、李伸、叅將鍾坤秀、張四維、門崇文。前期以
translation_en:
… assessed and allocated military supplies, enabling the many scholars of Linghai to attend the examination at ease. At the appointed time, the more than 2,700 scholars selected by Wang Xueyan, Surveillance Assistant Commissioner serving as Education Intendant, were assembled. The examination compound was sealed, and they were examined in three sessions. Dasheng and Instructor Huang Shiyuan served as Examiners. Professor Qin Shaoyi and Instructors Sun Yao, Tong Tianyin, Zeng Chen, Xiao Biao, Zhai Wuzhong, and Zeng Shiyan served as Associate Examiners.

Those managing affairs inside the compound were Left Provincial Administration Commissioner Liu Tinggao and Left Provincial Administration Vice Commissioner Feng Jin, serving as Proctors; and Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Xiong Kui and Surveillance Vice Commissioner Zhang Zihong, supervising the examination. Security outside was handled by Left Provincial Administration Assistant Commissioner Feng Gaomo; Surveillance Vice Commissioners He Lou, Zheng Weicheng, and Song Dawu; Surveillance Assistant Commissioners Huangfu Huan and Li Shen; and Assistant Regional Commanders Zhong Kunxiu, Zhang Siwei, and Men Chongwen. Before the appointed date, on account of …

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
入
賀行者右參政劉慤僉事王學
都指揮僉事金堂以考績行
者左參議袁應樞皆與聞之
旣撤棘得士之中式者七十
有五人擇其文二十篇爲錄
以
===
獻甚盛典也大昇當序諸首簡竊
惟徐兗荆揚以南皆海隅之
地也書稱堯舜之德曰帝光
天之下至于海隅蒼生周乃
成文王功于不怠則曰丕冒
海隅出日罔不率俾今泰山
有日觀而羅浮亦宵中見日
punctuated:
入賀行者，右參政劉慤、僉事王學、都指揮僉事金堂；以考績行者，左參議袁應樞，皆與聞之。旣撤棘，得士之中式者七十有五人，擇其文二十篇爲錄，以獻，甚盛典也。
大昇當序諸首簡，竊惟徐兗荆揚以南，皆海隅之地也。《書》稱堯舜之德曰：「帝光天之下，至于海隅蒼生。」周乃成文王功于不怠，則曰：「丕冒海隅出日，罔不率俾。」今泰山有日觀，而羅浮亦宵中見日。
translation_en:
…Those departing to offer congratulations at court—Liu Que, Right Administration Vice Commissioner; Wang Xue, Surveillance Assistant Commissioner; and Jin Tang, Assistant Regional Military Commissioner—and Yuan Yingshu, Left Administration Assistant Commissioner, who was departing for his performance evaluation, all participated in these deliberations. Once the examination enclosure was opened, seventy-five candidates had qualified. Twenty of their essays were selected and compiled into a record for presentation to the throne: a most splendid observance.
It falls to me, Dasheng, to supply a preface at the beginning of this record. I humbly reflect that the lands south of Xu, Yan, Jing, and Yang all lie toward the coastal extremities. Praising the virtue of Yao and Shun, the Book of Documents says: “The emperor’s radiance illuminated all beneath Heaven, reaching the common people at the corners of the seas.” Of Zhou’s untiring completion of King Wen’s achievement, it says: “His protection extended broadly to the ocean’s edge, where the sun rises; none failed to follow and obey.” Now Mount Tai has its Sun-Viewing Peak, while on Mount Luofu, too, the sun can be seen in the middle of the night…

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
蓋陽德所鍾先於東南而山
澤之氣通焉爾氣通則地靈
粵才夙稱海濱鄒魯則有繇
也欽惟
太祖高皇帝光宅四海詒謀
列聖惟以堯舜執中之傳徵諸
寶訓爲萬世法者至矣迨我
===
睿宗獻皇帝
純德同符乎文王
大化淳流于南國
聖天子繼
統中興治道隆盛凡在
光被仁覆之下懷生之類亦皆
翕然闓澤而況駿茂異倫者
punctuated: 蓋陽德所鍾，先於東南，而山澤之氣通焉爾。氣通則地靈，粵才夙稱海濱鄒魯，則有繇也。欽惟太祖高皇帝光宅四海，詒謀列聖，惟以堯舜執中之傳，徵諸寶訓，爲萬世法者至矣。迨我睿宗獻皇帝，純德同符乎文王，大化淳流于南國。聖天子繼統中興，治道隆盛，凡在光被仁覆之下，懷生之類，亦皆翕然闓澤，而況駿茂異倫者
translation_en:
For the potency of yang gathers first in the southeast, where the vital energies of mountains and waters communicate. When these energies communicate, the land becomes numinous. There is thus a reason why Guangdong, for its talent, has long been called a coastal Zou and Lu—the homelands of Mencius and Confucius.
We reverently reflect that Emperor Taizu Gao gloriously ruled all within the Four Seas and bequeathed his plans to the succession of sage emperors. Taking solely the tradition of Yao and Shun’s holding fast to the mean, he gave it authoritative expression in his treasured instructions, establishing a supremely perfect model for all ages. In the time of our Emperor Ruizong Xian, his pure virtue matched that of King Wen, and his great transforming influence flowed in its purity through the southern lands. The sage Son of Heaven succeeded to the imperial line and brought about a restoration; the Way of government flourishes abundantly. All living beings beneath the reach of his radiance and the shelter of his benevolence unite in rejoicing in his beneficence [?], how much more, then, those of outstanding talent who surpass their fellows…

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
乎多士當斯世獲薦于鄉雖
唐虞舉黎獻成周登賢能何
以加兹且是科也歲值辛酉
稽諸字訓其義甚美蓋辛者
新也酉者有也易曰富有之
謂大業日新之謂盛德揆厥
所元則乾父坤母賦人以易
===
簡之理故德性之知本無不
能也擴而充之善端弘則德
進而可久久而無窮則日新
矣舉而措之才美著則業脩
而可大大而無外則富有矣
是乃學以至乎聖人配乎天
地者也業隨德而時發其諸
punctuated: 乎？多士當斯世，獲薦于鄉，雖唐虞舉黎獻、成周登賢能，何以加兹？且是科也，歲值辛酉，稽諸字訓，其義甚美。蓋辛者，新也；酉者，有也。《易》曰：「富有之謂大業，日新之謂盛德。」揆厥所元，則乾父坤母賦人以易簡之理，故德性之知本無不能也。擴而充之，善端弘則德進而可久，久而無窮則日新矣；舉而措之，才美著則業脩而可大，大而無外則富有矣。是乃學以至乎聖人、配乎天地者也。業隨德而時發，其諸
translation_en:
…? For the many scholars who live in this age and gain recommendation at the Provincial Examination, how could even the selection of worthy men under Tang and Yu, or the advancement of the worthy and capable in Zhou, surpass this? Moreover, this examination falls in the xinyou year. Examining the meanings of these characters, we find their significance most auspicious. Xin means “new,” and you means “to possess.” The Book of Changes says: “Abundant possession is called great achievement; daily renewal is called flourishing virtue.” If we consider their source, Qian as father and Kun as mother endow human beings with the principles of ease and simplicity. Thus, the knowledge inherent in our moral nature is originally capable of everything.

By expanding and fully developing it, the beginnings of goodness are enlarged, and virtue advances and can endure; enduring without limit, it is renewed daily. By putting it into practice, the excellence of one’s abilities becomes manifest, and achievement is cultivated and can become great; so great that nothing lies outside it, it constitutes abundant possession. This is how, through learning, one reaches sagehood and becomes a counterpart to Heaven and Earth. Achievement follows virtue and manifests itself at the proper times; might this perhaps…

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
地承天而時行與乾以易知
者誠也坤以簡能者才也敬
義夾持少有不至則脩詞居
業僞焉而已僞則陰晻難親
嵬瑣僨事罔與成功將焉用
之唐虞成周所謂文章道藝
者豈顓以此求賢論秀哉帝
===
臣所以敬應作人所以譽髦
必有鼓舞之術默而成之者
矣是以元首執要而股肱宣
力陶鈞獨運而羣材緝熙致
中和召休徵如詩書所稱者
皆本其道心推之安見其繁
且難也自力政廢德而敷奏
punctuated: 地承天而時行與？乾以易知者，誠也；坤以簡能者，才也。敬義夾持，少有不至，則脩詞居業，僞焉而已。僞則陰晻難親，嵬瑣僨事，罔與成功，將焉用之？唐虞成周所謂文章道藝者，豈顓以此求賢論秀哉？帝臣所以敬應，作人所以譽髦，必有鼓舞之術，默而成之者矣。是以元首執要而股肱宣力，陶鈞獨運而羣材緝熙。致中和，召休徵，如《詩》《書》所稱者，皆本其道心推之，安見其繁且難也？自力政廢德，而敷奏
translation_en:
…as earth receives Heaven’s influence and acts in accordance with the seasons? That Qian knows through ease is sincerity; that Kun accomplishes through simplicity is ability. Reverent attentiveness and righteousness must sustain one on either side. If either falls even slightly short, then refining one’s words and establishing one’s work amount to nothing but falsity. Falsity makes a person secretive and obscure, difficult to approach, deviant and petty, bringing undertakings to ruin and contributing nothing to their success. What use could such a person be? Could what were called literary accomplishments, the Way, and the arts in the ages of Tang Yao, Yu Shun, and the flourishing Zhou have been the sole basis for seeking worthy men and judging outstanding talent? In the reverent responsiveness of ruler and ministers, and in nurturing men and commending the eminent [?], there must have been an art of inspiring them, bringing them to fulfillment without words.
Thus the head holds fast to the essentials while the limbs exert their strength: the ruler alone turns the potter’s wheel of transformation, and the many talented men advance toward brilliance. Attaining equilibrium and harmony and calling forth auspicious signs, as celebrated in the Book of Odes and the Book of Documents—all these proceed from extending the moral mind. How could this be regarded as complicated and difficult? Ever since government by force displaced virtue, the presentation of reports…

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
明試以及賓興之典一切不
行人各以其習尚自見於是
善為說辭者則言語而已矣
長於經濟者則政事而已矣
精於稽古者則文學而已矣
能知本者其惟顏氏之子乎
為學而見道卓爾非不博文
===
也為仁而請事斯語非不聽
言也為邦而得聞治法非不
興事也服膺聖教而融諸德
性則典禮由衷而出約而履
之所謂道心則然也彼辯易
簡者乃盡去言語文字事理
以為障無乃非博約之教乎
punctuated: 明試以及賓興之典，一切不行。人各以其習尚自見，於是善為說辭者則言語而已矣，長於經濟者則政事而已矣，精於稽古者則文學而已矣。能知本者，其惟顏氏之子乎？為學而見道卓爾，非不博文也；為仁而請事斯語，非不聽言也；為邦而得聞治法，非不興事也。服膺聖教而融諸德性，則典禮由衷而出，約而履之，所謂道心則然也。彼辯易簡者乃盡去言語、文字、事理，以為障，無乃非博約之教乎？
translation_en:
…the clear testing of performance, and even the rites for honoring and recommending worthy men as guests—all ceased to be practiced. Each person displayed himself according to his accustomed pursuits. Thus, those skilled in persuasive speech confined themselves to eloquence; those accomplished in ordering the realm confined themselves to administrative affairs; and those expert in investigating antiquity confined themselves to textual learning. Was the son of the Yan family, Yan Hui, perhaps the only one who understood the root?

In pursuing learning, he perceived the Way standing loftily before him; this did not mean that he failed to broaden his learning through cultural writings. In practicing benevolence, he asked to put the Master's words into practice; this did not mean that he failed to heed instruction. In asking about governing a state, he was taught methods of rule; this did not mean that he failed to undertake practical affairs. He cherished the sage's teachings in his heart and integrated them into his moral nature. Thus, institutions and rites issued from within his heart, and he practiced them by holding to their essentials. Such is what is called the moral mind. Yet those who expound ease and simplicity entirely discard speech, writing, and the principles of affairs, regarding them as obstructions. Surely this is contrary to the teaching of broad learning and restraint through essentials?

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
於戲立教雖善好學者鮮則
遯世而道弗行矣今多士將
進而服采濟時則有孔顏之
所不及為者平日所學謂何
而德業可汨沒無聞哉夫帝
王效天法地懋建德業必得
人而後有成故舜之承堯也
===
得五臣焉武王之繼述文王
也得九人焉其同心共事必
先其大且急者天下方饑且
溺則禹稷視為由己必地平
天成烝民乃粒以至神龜出
洛錫聖敘疇而後其心始安
周公之留君奭以夾輔也曰
punctuated: 於戲！立教雖善，好學者鮮，則遯世而道弗行矣。今多士將進而服采濟時，則有孔顏之所不及為者。平日所學謂何，而德業可汨沒無聞哉？夫帝王效天法地，懋建德業，必得人而後有成。故舜之承堯也，得五臣焉；武王之繼述文王也，得九人焉。其同心共事，必先其大且急者。天下方饑且溺，則禹稷視為由己，必地平天成，烝民乃粒，以至神龜出洛，錫聖敘疇，而後其心始安。周公之留君奭以夾輔也，曰：
translation_en: Alas! However excellent the teaching established, if those who delight in learning are few, one must withdraw from the world, and the Way will not prevail. Now you assembled scholars are about to advance into office and serve the needs of the age; you will thus have opportunities to accomplish what Confucius and Yan Hui were unable to accomplish. What, then, has your everyday learning amounted to, if your virtue and achievements may sink into oblivion, unheard of? Emperors and kings model themselves on Heaven and Earth and strive to establish virtue and great achievements, but they must obtain worthy men before they can succeed. Thus Shun, in succeeding Yao, obtained five ministers; King Wu, in carrying forward King Wen’s work, obtained nine men. Working together with one purpose, they necessarily gave priority to the greatest and most urgent tasks. When the people under Heaven were starving and drowning, Yu and Ji regarded this as their own responsibility. Only when the land had been put in order, Heaven’s work accomplished, and the multitude supplied with grain—even to the point that the divine turtle emerged from the Luo River, bestowing on the sage the ordered categories—could their hearts finally be at ease. When the Duke of Zhou sought to retain Lord Shi to assist in supporting the ruler, he said: …

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
耇造德不降我則鳴鳥不聞
必致隆平頌清廟詠鳳凰于
卷阿以證成功而後其心始
安何者才與誠合動天感神
則瑞應固其宜也豈惟是哉
伏生班固亦言之矣明良喜
起徵表于天俊乂百工相和
===
而歌卿雲帝乃倡之有曰日
月光華旦復旦兮言日新也
文王之化不徒應於麟趾騶
虞他如赤烏白雉玄秬黃麰
之事君臣動色左右相趨蓋
用昭明寅畏承聿懷之福天
保歌之有曰俾爾多益以莫
punctuated: 「耇造德不降我，則鳴鳥不聞。」必致隆平，頌《清廟》，詠鳳凰于《卷阿》，以證成功，而後其心始安。何者？才與誠合，動天感神，則瑞應固其宜也。豈惟是哉？伏生、班固亦言之矣。明良喜起，徵表于天，俊乂百工相和而歌《卿雲》，帝乃倡之，有曰：「日月光華，旦復旦兮。」言日新也。文王之化，不徒應於麟趾、騶虞，他如赤烏、白雉、玄秬、黃麰之事，君臣動色，左右相趨，蓋用昭明寅畏，承聿懷之福。《天保》歌之，有曰：「俾爾多益，以莫
translation_en:
…“Had the elders of accomplished virtue not come down to us, the singing bird would not have been heard.” They had to bring about consummate peace, sing the praises expressed in “The Pure Temple,” and celebrate the phoenix in “The Winding Hill,” thereby attesting to their achievement; only then were their hearts at ease. Why was this? When ability unites with sincerity, moving Heaven and stirring the spirits, auspicious responses naturally follow. Nor was this all. Fu Sheng and Ban Gu also spoke of it. When an enlightened ruler and worthy ministers joyfully roused one another to action, signs appeared in Heaven. Eminent men and the officials of the various offices joined in singing “The Auspicious Clouds,” with the emperor leading them. Its words include: “The sun and moon shine brightly; dawn follows dawn!” This speaks of daily renewal.

The transforming influence of King Wen elicited responses not only in the qilin’s hoof and the zouyu beast, but also in such manifestations as the red crow, white pheasant, black millet, and yellow barley. Ruler and ministers showed their emotion, and attendants on either side hastened forward. In this way they manifested reverence and awe and received the blessings that came to them. “Heaven Protects” sings of this, saying: “May you be granted ever greater increase, so that none…”

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
不庶言富有也方今諸福之
物可致之祥疊見駢臻不可
殫紀殆有前史靡得而言者
焉玆計偕行矣休烈淳耀時
至氣和其尚體天地之撰哉
日躔壽星萬寶收成道荆揚
濯江漢而觀南國恭儉之風
===
逖聽
恩紀集詠禾稼耕織諸篇而繹
思之則知
睿宗之厚民生猶岐周也懷保惠
鮮仁翔于裨海之外而人無
能名其藏諸用而為
業之大者耶日躔奎璧百嘉鬯
punctuated: 不庶，言富有也。方今諸福之物、可致之祥，疊見駢臻，不可殫紀，殆有前史靡得而言者焉。玆計偕行矣，休烈淳耀，時至氣和，其尚體天地之撰哉！日躔壽星，萬寶收成，道荆揚，濯江漢，而觀南國恭儉之風。逖聽《恩紀集》詠禾稼耕織諸篇而繹思之，則知睿宗之厚民生猶岐周也。懷保惠鮮，仁翔于裨海之外，而人無能名，其藏諸用而為業之大者耶？日躔奎璧，百嘉鬯
translation_en:
…“none fail to abound”: this speaks of abundant possessions. At present, objects betokening every blessing and auspicious signs that may be called forth appear repeatedly and arrive together, beyond all possibility of exhaustive record. Indeed, there are perhaps some that earlier histories never had occasion to describe. Now you depart with the provincial tribute delegation. Glorious achievements shine with pure brilliance; the season has arrived and the vital forces are harmonious. May you embody the workings of Heaven and Earth!

When the sun enters Shouxing, the myriad treasures of the fields reach harvest. Traveling through Jing and Yang, washing in the Jiang and Han rivers, you will observe the customs of reverence and frugality in the southern lands. Hearing from afar the poems on grain crops, plowing, and weaving in the Collection of Records of Grace (Enji ji) [?], and pondering their meaning, you will recognize that Ruizong’s generous care for the people’s livelihood resembled that of the Zhou at Qi. Cherishing and protecting the people, showing kindness to the distressed, his benevolence extends beyond the surrounding seas, yet none can adequately name it. Is this not the greatness of his achievement, concealed within its practical workings?

When the sun enters Kui and Bi, the hundred fine things flourish…

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
遂道徐兗以入燕瞻望
大朝之門高朗達天朱紱青衿攄
獻其忠者濟濟如也追誦本
始則知
太祖遏元虜以肇人文而
聖天子億萬年執中之治顯諸仁
而爲
===
德之盛者永永無極矣謂之超虞
邁唐信矣哉向之進脩也帝
制王猷稽古有得猶見日於
海隅也乃今
盛德大業上下與天地同流者身
親見之獲近
清光而夙夜匪懈卽所以事
punctuated: 遂。道徐兗以入燕，瞻望大朝之門，高朗達天，朱紱青衿，攄獻其忠者濟濟如也。追誦本始，則知太祖遏元虜以肇人文，而聖天子億萬年執中之治，顯諸仁而爲德之盛者，永永無極矣。謂之超虞邁唐，信矣哉！向之進脩也，帝制王猷，稽古有得，猶見日於海隅也。乃今盛德大業，上下與天地同流者，身親見之，獲近清光而夙夜匪懈，卽所以事
translation_en:
…come to fruition. Passing through Xu 徐 and Yan 兗 to enter Yan 燕, I gazed toward the gates of the great court, lofty and radiant, reaching to Heaven. Officials wearing vermilion knee aprons and scholars in blue collars gathered in great numbers to express and offer their loyalty. Recalling and reciting the beginnings of the dynasty, I understood how Taizu checked the Yuan barbarians and inaugurated civilized culture, and how the sage Son of Heaven’s governance, holding fast to the Mean for countless ages, manifests itself in benevolence and constitutes an abundance of virtue that endures forever without limit. How true it is to say that this surpasses Yu and Tang—the ages of Shun and Yao!

In my earlier pursuit of learning and self-cultivation, I gained some understanding of imperial institutions and kingly plans through studying antiquity, yet this was like seeing the sun from a remote corner of the sea. Now I have personally witnessed this abundant virtue and great achievement, flowing together with Heaven and Earth above and below. To be admitted near the sovereign’s pure radiance and remain tireless morning and night is precisely the means of serving…

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
天也昭受
天寵自今始矣瑞應繇人貴乎自
立若五人暨九人者位冠羣
臣業施後世豈眞不可睎而
及哉其德性固與人同也張
九齡曰功濟生人者其祥大
崔與之曰人瑞國之寶彼皆
===
鄉先正也才與誠合能不愧
乎其言豈非久大之期與語
曰唐虞之際於斯爲盛大昇
不佞敢拜手颺言上以爲
今日頌而下以爲多士勖
直隸蘇州府太倉州儒學學
正宋大昇謹序
punctuated:
天也。昭受天寵，自今始矣。瑞應繇人，貴乎自立。若五人暨九人者，位冠羣臣，業施後世，豈眞不可睎而及哉？其德性固與人同也。張九齡曰：「功濟生人者，其祥大。」崔與之曰：「人瑞，國之寶。」彼皆鄉先正也。才與誠合，能不愧乎其言，豈非久大之期與？語曰：「唐虞之際，於斯爲盛。」大昇不佞，敢拜手颺言，上以爲今日頌，而下以爲多士勖。
直隸蘇州府太倉州儒學學正宋大昇謹序。
translation_en:
…Heaven. From this moment begins the manifest reception of Heaven’s favor. Auspicious signs arise through human beings; what matters is establishing oneself. As for the five men and the nine men, their rank stood above all other ministers, and their achievements benefited later generations. Can they truly be beyond our aspiration and attainment? Their moral nature was surely the same as that of others. Zhang Jiuling said, “Those whose achievements benefit the people receive great auspicious signs.” Cui Yuzhi said, “An auspicious person is a treasure of the state.” Both were upright worthies of this province in earlier times. If talent is joined with sincerity, and one can live up to their words, is this not grounds to expect enduring greatness? The Analects says, “From the time of Tang and Yu, it was at this time that talent flourished most.” I, Dasheng, untalented though I am, venture to bow with clasped hands and raise these words: offered upward, they praise the present day; addressed below, they encourage the many scholars.
Preface respectfully written by Song Dasheng, Instructor in the Confucian School of Taicang Subprefecture, Suzhou Prefecture, in the Directly Administered Region.

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
子貢問曰賜也何如子曰女器也曰何器
也曰瑚璉也
仲尼祖述堯舜憲章文武
仁之於父子也義之於君臣也禮之於賓
主也智之於賢者也聖人之於天道也
易
嘉會足以合禮
===
天施地生其益无方
以言乎天地之間則備矣夫乾其靜也專
其動也直是以大生焉夫坤其靜也翕
其動也闢是以廣生焉廣大配天地
物大然後可觀故受之以觀
書
夔曰於予擊石拊石百獸率舞庶尹允諧
帝庸作歌曰勅天之命惟時惟幾乃歌
曰股肱喜哉元首起哉百工熙哉皐陶
banxin: 鄉試錄 六 一八
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

子貢問曰：「賜也何如？」子曰：「女器也。」曰：「何器也？」曰：「瑚璉也。」

仲尼祖述堯舜，憲章文武。

仁之於父子也，義之於君臣也，禮之於賓主也，智之於賢者也，聖人之於天道也。

易

嘉會足以合禮。

天施地生，其益无方。

以言乎天地之間，則備矣。夫乾，其靜也專，其動也直，是以大生焉。夫坤，其靜也翕，其動也闢，是以廣生焉。廣大配天地。

物大然後可觀，故受之以觀。

書

夔曰：「於！予擊石拊石，百獸率舞，庶尹允諧。」帝庸作歌，曰：「勅天之命，惟時惟幾。」乃歌曰：「股肱喜哉！元首起哉！百工熙哉！」皐陶
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

Zigong asked, “What sort of person am I, Ci?” The Master said, “You are a vessel.” He asked, “What kind of vessel?” The Master said, “A hu or a lian—a precious sacrificial vessel.”

Zhongni transmitted the traditions of Yao and Shun and took Wen and Wu as his models.

Benevolence in the relationship between father and son; righteousness in the relationship between ruler and minister; ritual propriety in the relationship between guest and host; wisdom in discerning the worthy; and the sage’s relationship to the Way of Heaven.

Book of Changes

The bringing together of what is excellent suffices to accord with ritual propriety.

Heaven bestows and earth brings forth; their benefits have no bounds.

Speaking of what lies between heaven and earth, everything is complete within it. Qian, when still, is concentrated; when moving, it is direct. Thus it brings forth on a great scale. Kun, when still, is closed; when moving, it opens. Thus it brings forth on a broad scale. Its breadth and greatness match heaven and earth.

Only after things become great can they be contemplated; therefore, the hexagram that follows is Guan (Contemplation).

Book of Documents

Kui said, “Ah! I strike the stone chimes and tap them gently; the hundred beasts all dance, and the many officials are truly in harmony.” The emperor thereupon composed a song, saying, “Attend reverently to Heaven’s mandate; heed the times and the first stirrings of change.” Then he sang, “When the arms and legs rejoice, the head rises to action, and all officials flourish!” Gao Yao…

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
拜手稽首颺言曰念哉率作興事愼乃
憲欽哉屢省乃成欽哉乃賡載歌曰元
首明哉股肱良哉庶事康哉
俾萬姓咸曰大哉王言又曰一哉王心克
綏先王之祿永底烝民之生
五者來備各以其敘庶草蕃廡
六服羣辟罔不承德
詩
七月食瓜八月斷壺九月叔苴采荼薪樗
===
食我農夫九月築場圃十月納禾稼黍
稷重穋禾麻菽麥
卜爾百福如幾如式
天生烝民有物有則民之秉彝好是懿德
我受命溥將自天降康豐年穰穰
春秋
秋及江人黃人伐陳〔僖公四年〕
春王二月秦人入滑 夏四月辛巳晉人
及姜戎敗秦于殽〔俱僖公三十有三年〕
punctuated:
拜手稽首，颺言曰：「念哉！率作興事，愼乃憲，欽哉！屢省乃成，欽哉！」乃賡載歌曰：「元首明哉！股肱良哉！庶事康哉！」
俾萬姓咸曰：「大哉，王言！」又曰：「一哉，王心！」克綏先王之祿，永底烝民之生。
五者來備，各以其敘，庶草蕃廡。
六服羣辟，罔不承德。
詩
七月食瓜，八月斷壺，九月叔苴，采荼薪樗，食我農夫。九月築場圃，十月納禾稼，黍稷重穋，禾麻菽麥。
卜爾百福，如幾如式。
天生烝民，有物有則。民之秉彝，好是懿德。
我受命溥將，自天降康，豐年穰穰。
春秋
秋，及江人、黃人伐陳。〔僖公四年〕
春，王二月，秦人入滑。夏，四月辛巳，晉人及姜戎敗秦于殽。〔俱僖公三十有三年〕
translation_en:
…He bowed with his hands joined and his head to the ground, and proclaimed: “Be mindful! In leading undertakings and initiating affairs, be careful of your standards. Be reverent! Repeatedly examine your accomplishments. Be reverent!” Then he continued the song: “When the head is enlightened, the arms and legs are worthy, and all affairs prosper!”

Let all the people say, “How great are the king’s words!” and also, “How single-minded is the king’s heart!” Thus you can secure the blessings of the former kings and establish the people’s livelihood forever.

When all five come in full measure, each in its proper sequence, all vegetation flourishes luxuriantly.

Among the many rulers of the six service zones, none failed to acknowledge his virtue.

Book of Odes

In the seventh month we eat melons; in the eighth month we cut gourds; in the ninth month we gather hemp seed. We pick bitter herbs and cut ailanthus for firewood, to feed our farmers. In the ninth month we prepare the threshing ground from the vegetable plots; in the tenth month we bring in the grain: millet and panicled millet, late-sown and early-sown grain, rice, hemp, beans, and wheat.

We divine a hundred blessings for you, just as you hope, just as is fitting.

Heaven gave birth to the multitude of people; for every thing there is a rule. The people hold to their constant nature and love this excellent virtue.

The mandate we have received is vast and great; Heaven sends down peace, with abundant harvests in plentiful years.

Spring and Autumn Annals

In autumn, together with men of Jiang and Huang, we attacked Chen. 〔Fourth year of Duke Xi.〕

In spring, in the second month by the royal calendar, men of Qin entered Hua. In summer, on the xinsi day of the fourth month, men of Jin and the Jiang Rong defeated Qin at Yao. 〔Both entries are from the thirty-third year of Duke Xi.〕

秋公會劉子晉侯齊侯宋公衛侯鄭伯曹
伯莒子邾子滕子薛伯杞伯小邾子于
平丘八月甲戌同盟于平丘〔俱昭公十有三年〕
禮記
===
凡養老有虞氏以燕禮夏后氏以饗禮殷
人以食禮周人脩而兼用之
故樂者天地之命中和之紀人情之所不
能免也
天子者與天地參故德配天地兼利萬物
禮之以和爲貴忠信之美優游之法
第貳場
論
萬世文字之祖
punctuated:
春王二月甲子，晉侯及秦師戰于彭衙，秦師敗績〔文公二年〕。秦人伐晉〔文公三年〕。〔年〕晉侯伐秦〔文公四年〕。
春，公孫歸父會楚子于宋〔宣公十有五年〕。
秋，公會劉子、晉侯、齊侯、宋公、衛侯、鄭伯、曹伯、莒子、邾子、滕子、薛伯、杞伯、小邾子于平丘。八月甲戌，同盟于平丘〔俱昭公十有三年〕。
禮記
凡養老，有虞氏以燕禮，夏后氏以饗禮，殷人以食禮，周人脩而兼用之。
故樂者，天地之命，中和之紀，人情之所不能免也。
天子者，與天地參，故德配天地，兼利萬物。
禮之以和爲貴，忠信之美，優游之法。
第貳場
論
萬世文字之祖
translation_en:
In spring, on the jiazi day of the second month of the royal calendar, the Marquis of Jin fought the army of Qin at Pengya. The army of Qin suffered a crushing defeat. 〔Second year of Duke Wen〕 The men of Qin attacked Jin. 〔Third year of Duke Wen〕 〔“Year”—a stray annotation [?]〕 The Marquis of Jin attacked Qin. 〔Fourth year of Duke Wen〕
In spring, Gongsun Guifu met the Viscount of Chu at Song. 〔Fifteenth year of Duke Xuan〕
In autumn, the duke met the Viscount of Liu, the Marquis of Jin, the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, the Earl of Cao, the Viscount of Ju, the Viscount of Zhu, the Viscount of Teng, the Earl of Xue, the Earl of Qi, and the Viscount of Lesser Zhu at Pingqiu. On the jiaxu day of the eighth month, they jointly concluded a covenant at Pingqiu. 〔Both in the thirteenth year of Duke Zhao〕
Record of Rites (Liji)
In caring for the aged, the house of Yu used the rites of convivial banquets; the sovereigns of Xia used the rites of ceremonial feasts; and the people of Yin used the rites of formal meals. The people of Zhou refined these and employed them together.
Thus music is the mandate of Heaven and Earth [?], the ordering principle of balance and harmony, and something human feelings cannot do without.
The Son of Heaven forms a triad with Heaven and Earth. Hence his virtue matches Heaven and Earth, and he benefits all things alike.
Ritual esteems harmony: it is the beauty of loyalty and trustworthiness, and the model of ease and composure.
Second Session
Discourse
The progenitor of writing for all ages.

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
詔誥表內科一道
擬漢議振貸及養老詔文帝元年
擬唐以李泌爲中書侍郎同平章事誥貞
元二年
擬宋曾公亮進新唐書表嘉祐五年
判語五條
官吏給由
轉解官物
鄉飲酒禮
===
優恤軍屬
帶造段疋
第叄場
策五道
問孟子曰人倫明於上小民親於下夫惟
明倫也而後民知親親親親則愛身敬事
遠於刑辟仰率聖人之敎以臻仁壽之
域故曰聖人久於其道而天下化成豈
其微哉惟我
punctuated:
詔誥表內科一道。
擬漢議振貸及養老詔，文帝元年。
擬唐以李泌爲中書侍郎同平章事誥，貞元二年。
擬宋曾公亮進新唐書表，嘉祐五年。
判語五條。
官吏給由。
轉解官物。
鄉飲酒禮。
優恤軍屬。
帶造段疋。
第叄場。
策五道。
問：孟子曰：「人倫明於上，小民親於下。」夫惟明倫也，而後民知親親。親親則愛身敬事，遠於刑辟，仰率聖人之敎，以臻仁壽之域。故曰：「聖人久於其道，而天下化成。」豈其微哉！惟我
translation_en:
One topic from among edicts, proclamations, and memorials [the wording 內科 is doubtful].
Compose, in the manner of the Han, an edict calling for deliberation on relief loans and care for the elderly: the first year of Emperor Wen’s reign.
Compose, in the manner of the Tang, a proclamation appointing Li Mi as Vice Director of the Secretariat and Jointly Manager of Affairs: the second year of Zhenyuan.
Compose, in the manner of the Song, Zeng Gongliang’s memorial presenting the New History of the Tang: the fifth year of Jiayou.

Five legal judgments:
Issuing certificates of service to officials and clerks.
Forwarding government goods.
The district drinking ceremony.
Preferential relief for military dependents.
Manufacturing additional bolts of silk satin [?].

Third Session
Five policy questions

Question: Mencius said, “When human relationships are made clear by those above, the common people below are affectionate toward one another.” Only after these relationships have been made clear do the people understand affection for their kin. Affection for their kin leads them to cherish their persons and attend diligently to their duties, keeping far from penal punishment and reverently following the sages’ teachings, so as to attain a realm of benevolence and longevity. Thus it is said, “The sage perseveres in his Way, and all under Heaven is transformed and brought to completion.” Could its significance be slight? Our own …

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
太祖高皇帝甫當踐祚即申五常懷生之類孰
不佩誦興起而於
祖訓又禁後世不用墨劓剕宮之刑其滋培
國脉衛養元神以綿丕丕無疆之基者良有
由矣至我
皇上敬
天法
祖恭
已愛民壽考萬年自今伊始曩者出自
===
宸衷特脩
明倫大典一刊千古之謬以植萬世之綱常
頒布海宇
日照月臨皆曰
聖人之教我也頃
欲臣工慎刑罔干和氣仰塵
勅旨懇示
欽恤洋洋
聖訓雲行雨施又皆曰
punctuated: 太祖高皇帝甫當踐祚，即申五常，懷生之類孰不佩誦興起？而於《祖訓》又禁後世不用墨劓剕宮之刑，其滋培國脉、衛養元神，以綿丕丕無疆之基者，良有由矣。至我皇上，敬天法祖，恭已愛民，壽考萬年，自今伊始。曩者，出自宸衷，特脩《明倫大典》，一刊千古之謬，以植萬世之綱常，頒布海宇，日照月臨，皆曰：「聖人之教我也。」頃欲臣工慎刑，罔干和氣，仰塵勅旨，懇示欽恤。洋洋聖訓，雲行雨施，又皆曰：
translation_en:
…Emperor Taizu Gao, immediately upon ascending the throne, reaffirmed the Five Constant Virtues. Among all living people, who did not cherish and recite his teachings and rise to action? In the Ancestral Instructions, moreover, he forbade later generations to employ the punishments of tattooing, cutting off the nose, amputating the feet, and castration. There was indeed sound reason for these measures, which nourished the state's vital channels and protected its essential spirit, thereby perpetuating its mighty, boundless foundations.

Now our Emperor reveres Heaven, follows his ancestors, conducts himself reverently, and loves the people. May his longevity extend for ten thousand years, beginning this very day. Previously, prompted by his imperial heart, he specially commissioned the Great Compendium on Clarifying Human Relations (Minglun dadian), correcting at one stroke the errors of a thousand ages and establishing the cardinal bonds and constant virtues for ten thousand generations. It was promulgated throughout the realm, and wherever sun and moon shone, all said: “The sage is teaching us.” Recently, desiring his officials to exercise care in punishment and not disturb the harmonious vital energies, he graciously issued an imperial edict [?], earnestly instructing them to exercise reverent compassion. His abundant sagely instructions spread like moving clouds and nourishing rain, and again all said: …

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
聖人之生我也
好生之德洽於民心
帝祉靈承與
天無極天下之民熙熙皡皡歌舞
聖人之壽彌熾彌昌以迓億萬年永永之庥將
康衢華封不足尚矣何幸而躬逢其盛
哉諸士涵濡
聖澤鼓舞有年願鋪張而揚厲之用昭
謨烈於無窮
===
問夫道一而已矣道一則學為道者亦一
古今聖賢不容殊異焉也夷攷古昔帝
王所傳咸謂得統經傳稱說莫匪心法
然不能盡一焉何也說者謂六經之用
同歸乃戴記經解所述入國之敎及荀
卿楊雄氏所謂六經辨說各有攸指于
今沿為體要豈又不相為用與四書垂
訓孔門所授受也由觀魯論專言為仁
七篇之作竝詳仁義大學始敎以誠為
punctuated:
「聖人之生我也！」好生之德洽於民心，帝祉靈承，與天無極。天下之民熙熙皡皡，歌舞聖人之壽，彌熾彌昌，以迓億萬年永永之庥，將康衢華封不足尚矣。何幸而躬逢其盛哉！諸士涵濡聖澤，鼓舞有年，願鋪張而揚厲之，用昭謨烈於無窮。

問：夫道一而已矣，道一則學為道者亦一，古今聖賢不容殊異焉也。夷攷古昔帝王所傳，咸謂得統；經傳稱說，莫匪心法，然不能盡一焉，何也？說者謂六經之用同歸，乃戴記《經解》所述入國之敎，及荀卿、楊雄氏所謂六經辨說，各有攸指，于今沿為體要，豈又不相為用與？四書垂訓，孔門所授受也。由觀魯論專言為仁，七篇之作竝詳仁義，《大學》始敎以誠為
translation_en:
…“It is the sage who gives us life!” His virtue of cherishing life pervades the hearts of the people. August blessings are numinously received, boundless as Heaven. All the people under Heaven, joyful and contented, sing and dance to celebrate the sage’s longevity, ever more flourishing and prosperous, welcoming everlasting blessings for countless millions of years. Even the songs at Kangqu and the well-wishes of the border warden of Hua would scarcely surpass this. How fortunate we are to witness such splendor in person! You scholars have long been steeped in the sage’s beneficence and inspired by it. We ask you to expound and extol it fully, thereby making his great plans and achievements shine forth for all time.

Question: The Way is one, and nothing more. Since the Way is one, the learning of those who pursue it must likewise be one; the sages and worthies of ancient and modern times cannot differ in this. Yet, examining what the sovereigns of antiquity transmitted, all are said to have received the orthodox succession; what the classics and their commentaries proclaim is invariably the method of cultivating the mind. Why, then, are they not entirely uniform? Commentators say that the functions of the Six Classics converge upon a common end. Yet the teachings discernible upon entering a state, as described in “Explanations of the Classics” in Dai’s Record of Rites, and the distinctions drawn among the Six Classics by Xun Qing and Yang Xiong, each have a particular purport. These have been followed down to the present as essential principles. Could it be that they do not also serve one another’s purposes? The teachings handed down in the Four Books were transmitted and received within the school of Confucius. Looking at them [?], the Analects of Lu speaks particularly of practicing benevolence; the work in seven books, the Mencius, expounds both benevolence and righteousness in detail; and the Great Learning, in its initial instruction, takes sincerity as…

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
自脩之首中庸入德則由明誠慎獨臻
于神化儒先遂以涵養省察體驗擴充
標别為諸書大都其果然與夫味道之
深則表章輔治皆聖人之徒也苟求諸
心而未得焉則古本之定疑孟之作亦
志於道者所不容已耶盍試言之以協
于一
問記曰今人與居古人與稽春秋而降賢
哲類出嘉言善行紀載備矣請以一二
===
所疑者與諸士詳之夫扣角之歌賤士
也而齊賴以霸駔儈之流薄計也而魏
式其閭豈固有當於心與深源既起以
素望也而無功於山桑房相醇儒殆重
器也而無救於陳濤豈真不適於用與
渭川之屯遺恨吞吳而與客圍棊者乃
成淮淝之捷好水之役無徵智膽而歡
呼達旦者顧定澶淵之功他如雲長偉
烈厄於麥城鵬舉精忠阻於恢復豈業
punctuated:
自脩之首，《中庸》入德則由明誠、慎獨臻于神化。儒先遂以涵養、省察、體驗、擴充標别為諸書大都，其果然與？夫味道之深，則表章輔治皆聖人之徒也。苟求諸心而未得焉，則古本之定、《疑孟》之作，亦志於道者所不容已耶？盍試言之，以協于一？
問：記曰：「今人與居，古人與稽。」春秋而降，賢哲類出，嘉言善行紀載備矣。請以一二所疑者與諸士詳之。夫扣角之歌，賤士也，而齊賴以霸；駔儈之流，薄計也，而魏式其閭。豈固有當於心與？深源既起以素望也，而無功於山桑；房相醇儒，殆重器也，而無救於陳濤。豈真不適於用與？渭川之屯，遺恨吞吳，而與客圍棊者乃成淮淝之捷；好水之役，無徵智膽，而歡呼達旦者顧定澶淵之功。他如雲長偉烈，厄於麥城；鵬舉精忠，阻於恢復。豈業
translation_en:
…the foremost requirement for self-cultivation, whereas in the Doctrine of the Mean, entry into virtue proceeds through understanding and sincerity, and through vigilance when alone, to attain spiritual transformation. Earlier Confucian scholars accordingly distinguished nurturing, self-examination, experiential understanding, and expansion as the principal purports of these respective books. Is this indeed so? Those who deeply savor the Way, elucidating its teachings and assisting government, are all followers of the sages. Yet if one seeks within the mind and has not attained understanding, are establishing the ancient text and composing Doubts about Mencius likewise undertakings that those devoted to the Way cannot forgo? Try explaining these matters so as to reconcile them into a unity.
Question: A record says, “Dwell with people of the present; consult people of antiquity.” From the Spring and Autumn period onward, worthy and wise men have appeared in succession, and their admirable words and good deeds have been amply recorded. Let us examine with you gentlemen one or two matters that occasion doubt. The man who sang while tapping an ox’s horn was of humble station, yet Qi relied on him to achieve hegemony. One belonging to the ranks of livestock brokers pursued a lowly livelihood, yet the ruler of Wei bowed against his carriage crossbar at his neighborhood gate. Was it because they possessed something that accorded with the ruler’s mind? Shenyuan was appointed on the strength of his long-standing reputation, yet achieved nothing at Shansang. Chief Minister Fang, a thoroughgoing Confucian scholar, was surely a man capable of bearing great responsibilities, yet could not avert disaster at Chentao. Were they truly unsuited to practical service? The encampment by the Wei River left the regret of swallowing up Wu [?], while the man who played encirclement chess with a guest achieved victory at Huai and Fei. In the battle of Haoshui, wisdom and courage yielded no proof of their worth, while the man who cheered until dawn nevertheless secured success at Chanyuan. Other examples include Yunchang, whose magnificent exploits ended in distress at Maicheng, and Pengju, whose unalloyed loyalty was thwarted in the work of restoration. Could their achievements …

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
有所限耶聖人之稱讓於先識國門之
待輸心六丈知固有不及耶夫名實之
際君子之愼所與也乃若所就固有幸
不幸者時耶勢耶抑所遇然也此皆稽
諸古而不能無疑者何以示我
問守令係重民生自古記之矣粵故嶺海
之外而制置之吏正己率物導利興理
代不乏人其循良較著者可更僕數與
夫來晚興歌酌泉勵操不可及矣乃有
===
務清簡而江山名廉易舊政而去珠復
返以至辭俸却餉投珍江中不持一硯
其潔己之致足以廉頑立懦豈聞風興
起者耶抑所植之性爾也又有脩敎庠
序督訓蠶桑使民從化就利而移石奠
瀧陶瓦禦火除苛政減繁課或化輕揚
之俗或感諸番之學無不膾炙人口雖
古所稱道德齊禮何加焉其進於是者
若誠以驅鱷文足起衰至今誦之不忘
punctuated:
有所限耶？聖人之稱，讓於先識；國門之待，輸心六丈：知固有不及耶？夫名實之際，君子之愼所與也。乃若所就，固有幸不幸者，時耶？勢耶？抑所遇然也？此皆稽諸古而不能無疑者，何以示我？

問：守令係重民生，自古記之矣。粵故嶺海之外，而制置之吏，正己率物，導利興理，代不乏人。其循良較著者，可更僕數與？夫來晚興歌，酌泉勵操，不可及矣。乃有務清簡而江山名廉，易舊政而去珠復返，以至辭俸却餉，投珍江中，不持一硯，其潔己之致，足以廉頑立懦，豈聞風興起者耶？抑所植之性爾也？又有脩敎庠序，督訓蠶桑，使民從化就利，而移石奠瀧，陶瓦禦火，除苛政，減繁課，或化輕揚之俗，或感諸番之學，無不膾炙人口。雖古所稱道德齊禮，何加焉？其進於是者，若誠以驅鱷，文足起衰，至今誦之不忘。
translation_en:
…were there limits to what they could accomplish? One acclaimed as a sage yielded to another’s foresight; in the matter of awaiting someone at the capital gate, he acknowledged the superiority of the venerable Sixth Gentleman [?]. Does understanding indeed have its limits? In weighing reputation against reality, the gentleman is cautious about whom he endorses. As for actual achievements, however, there are certainly fortunate and unfortunate outcomes. Is this a matter of timing, of circumstances, or simply of what one encounters? These are all matters that, when examined against antiquity, inevitably raise doubts. How would you instruct me?

Question: Prefects and county magistrates bear a weighty responsibility for the people’s livelihood; this has been recorded since antiquity. Yue lay beyond the mountain ranges and toward the sea, yet in every age it had officials who administered its affairs, rectified their own conduct to lead others, promoted benefits, and fostered good order. Could one enumerate its more conspicuously benevolent officials even with successive attendants taking turns? Those whose arrival inspired songs lamenting that they had come so late, and those who drank from a spring to fortify their integrity, were beyond emulation. Others pursued pure and simple government, so that rivers and mountains bore the name Lian, “incorruptible”; or changed former policies, so that pearls which had disappeared returned. Still others declined their salaries and rejected provisions, cast precious objects into the river, or took away not even a single inkstone. The perfection of their personal integrity could make the avaricious incorruptible and give the weak resolve. Were they inspired by hearing of exemplary conduct, or was this simply their innate disposition?

Others cultivated education in the schools and supervised instruction in sericulture and mulberry cultivation, enabling the people to embrace moral transformation and obtain material benefits. They moved rocks to quiet the rapids, made roof tiles to guard against fire, abolished oppressive policies, and reduced excessive levies. Some transformed frivolous customs; others inspired the various foreign peoples to pursue learning. All these deeds won universal praise. How could even the ancient ideal of guiding the people through virtue and ordering them through ritual surpass this? Among those who went still further was one whose sincerity drove away crocodiles and whose writings could revive a declining literary tradition; to this day people recite them without forgetting…

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
而提刑過化洗冤澤物有以啓伊洛之
傳而曁及南粤非特循良已也方今飭
新吏治屢廑
詔旨濱海之區思得若人理之意甚急也而未
之多見豈古今人不相及耶諸士繹思
古昔以論其世盍詳著之將以告夫有
位者
問東廣之患莫過山寇海倭然已非一日
矣文武諸臣防禦亦殫力焉今固未敢
===
再犯城郭顧漳贛惠潮峒酋糾結出沒
山海互爲倚伏乃民無完宇野有棄田
在在瘡痍公私告急矣憂時者可不諮
求其故乎議者曰盜皆民也撫之爲宜
彼慾已饜未有少挫敵鋒者撫以徇之
是厚其毒而誨之侮也又能必後之不
跳梁乎議者曰盜猶水也不決不潰毅
然大舉力爲驅除以雪神人之憤又恐
一隅兵食勞且費焉不能支也議者曰
punctuated:
而提刑過化，洗冤澤物，有以啓伊洛之傳而曁及南粤，非特循良已也。方今飭新吏治，屢廑詔旨，濱海之區思得若人理之，意甚急也，而未之多見。豈古今人不相及耶？諸士繹思古昔，以論其世，盍詳著之，將以告夫有位者。
問：東廣之患，莫過山寇海倭，然已非一日矣。文武諸臣防禦亦殫力焉，今固未敢再犯城郭。顧漳、贛、惠、潮峒酋糾結，出沒山海，互爲倚伏，乃民無完宇，野有棄田，在在瘡痍，公私告急矣。憂時者可不諮求其故乎？議者曰：「盜皆民也，撫之爲宜。」彼慾已饜，未有少挫敵鋒者，撫以徇之，是厚其毒而誨之侮也，又能必後之不跳梁乎？議者曰：「盜猶水也，不決不潰。」毅然大舉，力爲驅除，以雪神人之憤，又恐一隅兵食，勞且費焉，不能支也。議者曰：
translation_en:
…and the Judicial Commissioner’s transformative influence wherever he went, his redressing of wrongful convictions, and his beneficence toward living things helped open the way for the transmission of the teachings of Yi and Luo to reach Nanyue. These were more than merely achievements of conscientious and benevolent administration. Today, the reform of official administration has repeatedly engaged the Emperor’s concern in his edicts. His desire to obtain such men to govern the coastal regions is most urgent, yet few have been seen. Can it be that men today cannot equal those of antiquity? You candidates should reflect deeply on the past and assess its times. Why not set out your conclusions in detail, so that they may be conveyed to those holding office?
Question: Among the troubles afflicting Guangdong, none surpass mountain bandits and Japanese pirates at sea; these troubles have persisted for many days. The civil and military officials have exhausted their strength in defense, and at present the raiders indeed dare not attack the walled cities again. Yet the mountain chieftains of Zhang, Gan, Hui, and Chao band together, appearing and disappearing among the mountains and seas, supporting one another and concealing their forces. Thus the people have no intact dwellings, the countryside contains abandoned fields, devastation is everywhere, and both public and private resources are in crisis. Can those concerned about the times refrain from investigating the causes?
Some argue: “The bandits are all common people; it is appropriate to pacify them.” Their desires have already been sated [?], yet no one has even slightly blunted the enemy’s advance. To pacify them by yielding to them would compound their harm and teach them to treat us with contempt. Moreover, could we guarantee that they would not run rampant again afterward?
Others argue: “Bandits are like water: unless a breach is opened, they will not disperse.” We might resolutely mount a great campaign and strive to drive them out, thereby assuaging the indignation of spirits and men. Yet there is also the fear that supplying troops and provisions from a single region would entail labor and expense beyond its capacity to sustain. Others argue: …

title: 嘉靖四十年廣東鄉試錄
text:
倭突則攻海寇嘯則攻山官分信地兵
亦異施僨事者刑師律者否夫合三省
之力協庶官之心尤懼不逮乃分以任
之業相推諉安所圖成乎玆皆疑而未
决者諸士睹厥利害審切乃心必有犁
掃之術可佐安攘者幸昌言以對將採
而用焉
punctuated: 倭突，則攻海；寇嘯，則攻山。官分信地，兵亦異施。僨事者刑，師律者否。」夫合三省之力，協庶官之心，尤懼不逮，乃分以任之，業相推諉，安所圖成乎？玆皆疑而未决者。諸士睹厥利害，審切乃心，必有犁掃之術，可佐安攘者。幸昌言以對，將採而用焉。
translation_en:
…“When Japanese raiders strike, attack them at sea; when bandits rally, attack them in the mountains. Assign officials separate defense sectors and deploy troops accordingly. Punish those who cause operations to fail, but spare those who observe military discipline [?].” Even if we combine the strength of three provinces and unite the resolve of all the officials, we still fear that this will not suffice. Yet responsibilities are divided among them, and they already shift blame onto one another: how can success be expected?
These are all matters of doubt that remain unresolved. You candidates have observed the advantages and dangers involved and have weighed them earnestly in your hearts. Surely you have methods for sweeping away these threats that can help secure peace within and repel aggression from without. Please state your views fully in your answers; they will be considered for adoption and put into practice.
